sentences.text: Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
In this podcast we speak slow and easy English.
Today we talk about a unique and historical city.
The city is Gadamus.
Gadamus is in Libya.
Libya is a country in North Africa.
Gadamus is located near the desert and is known as the pearl of the desert.
Part 2.
Gadamus is an oasis city and oasis is a green place with water in the desert.
Palm trees and gardens grow there.
The city is surrounded by dry desert land.
Part 3.
Gadamus is very old.
People have lived there for thousands of years.
Long ago traders stopped there while crossing the Sahara desert.
The city was important for trade and travel.
Part 4.
The old town of Gadamus is very special.
The houses are made from mud, lime and palm wood.
The buildings help keep people cool in the hot weather.
The streets are narrow and shaded.
Part 5.
The design of the city is very smart.
Some streets are covered to protect people from the strong sun.
The houses are close together.
This creates cool and comfortable spaces.
Part 6.
Inside the houses there are beautiful decorations.
Walls and ceilings often have colorful designs.
Traditional carpets and handmade items are common.
The homes look simple outside but beautiful inside.
Part 7.
The people of Gadamus have a strong community life.
Families and neighbors help each other.
Traditions are very important.
People respect their culture and history.
Part 8.
Food in Gadamus is simple and traditional.
People eat bread, dates, couscous and meat dishes.
Dates from palm trees are very important.
Tea is also popular in daily life.
Part 9.
The weather in Gadamus is very hot in summer.
Temperatures can become extremely high.
People rest during the hottest hours of the day.
Life becomes more active in the evening.
Part 10.
At night the desert sky is very beautiful.
The stars shine brightly because there is little city light.
The air becomes cooler and calmer.
Many visitors enjoy the peaceful nights.
Part 11.
Gadamus is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
This means it is important for world culture and history.
People visit to learn about desert life and traditional architecture.
The old city is very unique.
Part 12.
Gadamus is a quiet city full of history and desert beauty.
The oasis, old houses and traditional culture make it special.
Visitors can experience a very different way of life.
Even though Gadamus is not very famous, it is a fascinating place to discover.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Amili.
See you in the next episode.
